body:
Projects now uses the whole-project status board, retaining its name, folder icon
and default phone shortcut. The former Projects grid and separate Main entry,
icon and screen are removed. Registration, opening and deletion remain available
alongside conditional status moves and folder/title filters.

Legacy Main links, navigation entries and saved defaults resolve to Projects
without automatic workspace rewrites. Original pending commands retain their
payload and recovery identity.

The combined 610-test gate and selected Chromium/WebKit board, menu, navigation,
responsive, loading, motion and deletion checks pass. The rebuilt existing HTTPS
app verifies 44 assets while preserving 33 prior resource versions/source hashes,
two Focus pins, both profiles' settings, roots and registrations, identity/epoch
and certificate. Full release acceptance remains open.

This supersedes the separate-view behavior of the previous Main result.
Evidence: progress/2026-10-04-projects-status-board.md.

metadata.summary: Replaced Main and the Projects overview with one Projects status board
